urls.title: Scaling Zyphra Hierarchical Attention to Trillions of Parameters | Zyphra

data.text:
Check out our blog post for more details:  https://t.co/XYVrSfHMBz

We are excited to continue scaling and improving ZHA and will share further results soon.

Conversely, GPT-OSS already struggles at long-context retrieval, which is then reflected by ZHA. These results show how intertwined ZHA’s success is with the quality of the underlying attention patterns, which is the key to its effectiveness. https://t.co/bZ7o1SgvDm

However, we find that latency principally depends on the quality of the model backbone. Nemotron and Mimo have pathologically uniform early attention layers, resulting in smaller ZHA efficiency gains.

Tuning those early layers may resolve this. https://t.co/Oamji1v364
Our latency modelling also predicts dramatic speedups at 10M context, ranging from 9x for Qwen and Nemotron and up to 60x for GPT-OSS-120B. https://t.co/oY8wGkzgk1

We converted leading open-source frontier-scale models Qwen3.8-2.4T, Nemotron-3.5-Super, MiMo-2.6-Pro, and GPT-OSS-120B to ZHA.

Qwen, Nemotron and MiMo retain nearly all reasoning, coding, and long-context performance. Qwen loses under 2 points on RULER at 1M tokens. https://t.co/voWeXpUFLP

We’ve scaled @ZyphraAI’s subquadratic attention method - ZHA - to leading open source multi-trillion parameter models across Nemotron, Qwen, Mimo, and GPT-OSS!

ZHA preserves reasoning and agentic performance while delivering 9-60x long-context speedups at 10M tokens. https://t.co/LE3NCYDkUZ

@ZyphraAI is a full stack superintelligence company based in San Francisco on a mission to enable sovereign AI through open models and multisilicon infrastructure.

Apply to join us! https://t.co/IvT1597VMI

Most of the revenue comes from cached input, since about 95% of AgentX input tokens hit the prefix cache. 

At these prices we keep a ~60% margin on both endpoints.

GLM-5.3-Flash (FP4) pricing per 1M tokens:

Input $0.1125
Cached input $0.0225
Output $0.1875

At 96 sessions per node and full utilization, each MI300X brings in $5.00 an hour at our list price, against listed hourly MI300X rents of $1.85–2.99. Stock SGLang brings in $1.06.

Running 128 sessions earns more, but p90 TTFT rises from 6.24 s to 12.96 s, so we run 96. https://t.co/cz3ECGBrNw

ZOE has 48x lower p90 time to first token (TTFT) than stock SGLang at 96 concurrent sessions:

ZOE = 6.24 s

Stock SGLang = 299.32 s https://t.co/ZEm8ak4HPS

ZOE generates 9.5x faster per user than stock SGLang on one 8xMI300X node using @SemiAnalysis_ AgentX (a replay of multi-turn coding agent sessions).

At 96 concurrent sessions p90 generation speed:

ZOE = 44.6 tokens/s per user
Stock SGLang = 4.7 tokens/s per user https://t.co/dgAjK1fJVP

We implemented a custom MoE kernel to enable MXFP4 quantization on MI300X. Expert weights are stored in MXFP4 in memory and converted to FP8 in registers just before the multiply. https://t.co/CDoJRDg8rS

GLM-5.3-Flash (FP4) is on Zyphra Inference at 25% below our FP8 price, served with the Zyphra Optimization Engine (ZOE) on @AMD Instinct MI300X.

With ZOE, p90 generation is 9.5x faster per user and p90 TTFT is 48x lower than stock SGLang.

Try it at: https://t.co/MEj9CytIIo https://t.co/IKA4F5UjL6
